thread:
Ava: Heads up — noticed ~30 orgs had span gaps around 10:12 UTC after we flipped quota backpressure on the per-org pipeline. Dashboards for those orgs show read-only tiles.
Raj: Is this the new per-org quota enforcement rollout? Which policy was flipped?
Ava: Yes, rollout of `per-org-backpressure-v2` at 10:10. infra-bot reported throttles to exporter pool.
infra-bot: [ALERT] exporter_pool_throttled: pool=org-exporters-v2 affected_orgs=34
Leon: Are spans actually being dropped or just buffered? We should avoid dropping — prefer queue/backpressure.
Maria: From traces I pulled, we're seeing 429s from exporter write path. Some exporters returned "quota exceeded" and otelcol dropped on error.
Sophia: UX note — customers saw dashboards lose cards and then reappear; they can't tell if data was lost. We need clear rollout messaging + a read-only badge.
Raj: Can we switch exporter client retry to NACK+backoff rather than immediate drop? Snippet:
```
exporter.retry_on_failure: true
exporter.max_retries: 5
exporter.backpressure: enable
```
Leon: That helps but doesn't fix indexing visibility during retention-migration. The read model uses per-org index aliases; if exporter stalls, the index write lag causes the console to show stale data.
Ava: Also RBAC got weird — after migration some orgs lost write perms on their telemetry namespace and got flagged as "readonly" via the policy service.
Maria: That was my change — I tightened namespace RBAC to deny writes during ttl-migration windows. Maybe too strict.
Sophia: Suggestion: staged rollout: keep RBAC permissive while quota backpressure is ramped, and show an in-console banner: "Telemetry delayed — partial retention migration in progress".
Ava: +1. For short-term fix: rollback the RBAC deny for the affected window and flip exporter retry strategy.
infra-bot: Deploy request queued: team=eng-platform owner=Leon id=PR-4521
Raj: After fix, let's add a per-org metric `telemetry.exporter.retry_rate` and alert when > 1% sustained over 5m.
Leon: Also add a dashboard widget that flags 'retention-migration' status per-org and shows whether index aliases are writable.
Sophia: I'll sketch UX copy for the banner and the read-only badge and drop into #product.
Maria: I'll open a PR to relax RBAC and add migration window tagging to namespace metadata (will link PR here).
Ava: Thanks — ping once PRs are up. Customers on the slack thread were confused, cc @customer-success.
Raj: Can we also post a short incident note to the console status page so customers don't assume data is lost?
Leon: Agreed. We'll treat this as an operational guidance item for the rollout checklist.
Ava: OK — owners: Leon (exporter/retry), Maria (RBAC/migration tagging), Sophia (UX copy + banner), Raj (alerts/metrics).
infra-bot: Action items created: #AI-759 (exporter retry), #AI-760 (RBAC rollback), #AI-761 (dashboard tile).
Ava: Good progress. Let's avoid drops in future — prefer durable buffering and clear signals to customers. :thumbsup:
